name: What happens after a roof lifespan assessment?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a roof lifespan assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: After your roof lifespan assessment, our team will provide you with a detailed report outlining our findings and recommendations. We'll then schedule a follow-up consultation to discuss the report, answer any questions you have, and explore options for repairs or replacement if needed. For any repair or replacement work, we ensure a clear scope of work and transparent pricing, allowing you to make informed decisions without pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll receive a detailed report and a consultation to discuss findings and recommended next steps for repairs or replacement.
